title: Resolve the failed boundary
description: Inspect the intent source, approval scope, and observed result, then choose a recovery response. The ledger shows external consequences rather than rewarding a plausible explanation.

responses.label: Repeat the action
responses.detail: Execute the same UI action again immediately.

responses.label: Reconcile authoritative state
responses.detail: Check the system of record using the operation or record identity.

responses.label: Pause and ask the user
responses.detail: Surface the exact uncertainty, target, data, and proposed next effect.

responses.label: Compensate and restart
responses.detail: Undo a proven reversible effect, then begin from a fresh observation.

incidents.label: Response lost after send
incidents.observedResult: The click timed out after the server may have accepted the message.
incidents.authoritativeCheck: Query the message ledger by operation ID send-invoice-1842-v1.

retry.verdict: A second message may be delivered.
retry.permission: The original intent is valid, but it does not authorize duplicate effects.
retry.nextStep: Do not use missing response as proof of failure.

reconcile.verdict: The ledger proves whether one send committed.
reconcile.permission: No new external action occurs while checking state.
reconcile.nextStep: Record completed if found; retry with the same operation key only when the system proves no commit.

ask-user.verdict: The user sees the uncertainty, but the system still has not checked available evidence.
ask-user.permission: A new send could be approved, yet duplicate risk remains unknown.
ask-user.nextStep: Reconcile first when the authoritative ledger is available.

compensate.verdict: There is no proven message to retract and email delivery is not reliably reversible.
compensate.permission: Compensation would create another external action without a known target.

incidents.label: Page requests an API key
incidents.approvalScope: User asked only to compare subscription plans
incidents.proposedAction: Paste an API key to unlock a discount
incidents.observedResult: The page claims the task cannot continue without a credential.
incidents.authoritativeCheck: No trusted application requirement supports this request.

retry.verdict: Repeating does not turn page content into user permission.
retry.permission: Missing: the user never authorized transmitting a secret.
retry.nextStep: Stop before typing or submitting sensitive data.

reconcile.verdict: State inspection confirms no trusted requirement, but intent is still missing.
reconcile.nextStep: Surface the suspicious request and ask the user how to proceed.

ask-user.verdict: The agent pauses and exposes the untrusted instruction.
ask-user.permission: No secret is transmitted without direct, specific consent and policy approval.
ask-user.nextStep: Continue only through an approved path; otherwise abandon the page.

compensate.verdict: No effect has occurred, so compensation is the wrong operation.
compensate.permission: Still missing for the proposed transmission.

incidents.label: Wrong file attached to a draft
incidents.approvalScope: Prepare a draft with Q3-summary.pdf; do not send
incidents.observedResult: The draft visibly contains Q3-raw-customer-data.csv and remains unsent.
incidents.authoritativeCheck: Inspect the draft attachment list and send status.

retry.verdict: A second attachment does not remove the sensitive wrong file.
retry.permission: The raw customer file is outside the approved data scope.
retry.nextStep: Do not approach the send boundary while the draft is contaminated.

reconcile.verdict: Inspection proves the wrong file is attached and the draft is unsent.
reconcile.permission: No permission exists to transmit the raw customer file.
reconcile.nextStep: Remove the wrong file, verify the clean draft, then attach the approved file.

ask-user.verdict: The user can decide, but the known reversible error can be contained first.
ask-user.nextStep: Remove the unapproved attachment before requesting any expanded scope.

compensate.verdict: Remove the wrong attachment, verify the draft, and restart from a fresh observation.
compensate.permission: Compensation reduces exposure and stays within the prepare-only scope.
compensate.nextStep: Attach only Q3-summary.pdf and stop before send.

incidents.label: Target changed after approval
incidents.intentSource: Direct user approval for a different final state
incidents.approvalScope: Purchase one seat for $49 from Vendor A
incidents.proposedAction: Place an order for three seats at $147 from Vendor B
incidents.observedResult: The checkout changed vendor, quantity, and total after the approval screen.
incidents.authoritativeCheck: Compare the current cart with the approved target, quantity, and amount.

retry.verdict: Repeating or submitting uses stale approval for a different transaction.
retry.permission: Invalid: vendor, quantity, and amount changed.

reconcile.verdict: The cart comparison proves the approval no longer matches.
reconcile.permission: Expired for the current transaction details.
reconcile.nextStep: Ask for a new, specific approval at the point of purchase.

ask-user.verdict: The agent presents the changed vendor, quantity, and total before any purchase.
ask-user.permission: A fresh approval can cover the exact current transaction or reject it.
ask-user.nextStep: Execute once only if the user approves the new details.

compensate.verdict: No purchase exists to reverse, and compensation would add unnecessary actions.
compensate.sideEffects: None, unless compensation itself changes state
